title: Vampire Vape Heisenberg Grape 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Heisenberg Grape Nic Salt adds an extra fruity twist to Vampire Vape’s award-winning flavour. The iconic sweet and frosty taste of Heisenberg features sweet, tangy Red Berries and sharp, icy Menthol in a refreshing combination that has become the stuff of legend. This iconic flavour takes on a new dimension with the addition of Grape, enhancing the cool berry flavour with the taste of rich and juicy red grapes. This premium Nic Salt e-liquid strikes the ideal balance between flavour and cloud production with its 50VG/50PG blend, making it an ideal choice for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod vape devices. Designed for those making the switch from smoking or vapers in search of swift, satisfying nicotine relief, Heisenberg Grape Nic Salt offers a super-smooth throat hit and efficient nicotine delivery. Thanks to its nicotine salts' alkaline formulation, this e-liquid achieves a higher nicotine concentration while maintaining a smoother experience than is possible with high-strength freebase nicotine. Nicotine is absorbed more rapidly into the bloodstream, providing almost instantaneous relief from nicotine cravings, and establishing it as a premium option for effectiveness and comfort. Discover more new twists on Heisenberg with Heisenberg Cola, Gum and Orange Nic Salt flavours!
